name: acad-annotative
description: Annotative objects and annotation scales: make text, dimensions, hatches and blocks carry several scale representations so one model annotates correctly at 1:50 and 1:100 without duplicating anything. Covers the drawing scale list, the current annotation scale, per-object scale representations and annotation visibility.
intent_examples: auto add scale to annotative objects
tekst ma byc widoczny w skali 1:100
which scales does this text have

tools_summary.name: add_annotation_scale
tools_summary.description: Give annotative objects a representation at one or more scales, so they appear in viewports set to those scales. An annotative object is invisible in a viewport whose scale it has no representation for - this is the tool that fixes 'my text disappeared on the 1:100 sheet'.
intent: tekst ma byc widoczny w skali 1:100

tools_summary.name: add_scale_to_list
tools_summary.description: Add an annotation scale to the drawing, e.g. name '1:25' with paperUnits 1 and drawingUnits 25. Idempotent - an existing name is updated rather than duplicated.

tools_summary.name: delete_scale_from_list
tools_summary.description: Remove an annotation scale from the drawing's list. Fails if the scale is in use by an annotative object or a viewport, rather than silently orphaning them.

tools_summary.name: get_annotation_settings
tools_summary.description: Report ANNOALLVISIBLE and ANNOAUTOSCALE, decoded. Read-only.

tools_summary.name: get_current_annotation_scale
tools_summary.description: Return the current annotation scale (CANNOSCALE) with its ratio. Read-only.

tools_summary.name: list_annotative_objects
tools_summary.description: Enumerate every annotative object in model space with the scales it carries. Pass scale to list only objects having a representation at that scale. Read-only.

tools_summary.name: list_object_annotation_scales
tools_summary.description: List which scale representations each given entity carries, plus whether it is annotative at all. Read-only. Call this before wondering why an object is missing from a sheet.
intent: which scales does this text have

tools_summary.name: list_scale_list
tools_summary.description: List every annotation scale defined in this drawing, with its paper:drawing ratio and which one is current. Read-only. These are the scales available to add_annotation_scale and to viewports.

tools_summary.name: remove_annotation_scale
tools_summary.description: Remove scale representations from annotative objects. The object stops appearing in viewports at those scales. An object's last remaining representation cannot be removed - use set_annotative false instead.

tools_summary.name: reset_scale_list
tools_summary.description: Reset the drawing's scale list to AutoCAD's defaults, dropping custom entries that are not in use. Scales still referenced by objects or viewports are kept and reported.

tools_summary.name: set_annotation_visibility
tools_summary.description: ANNOALLVISIBLE: show every annotative object regardless of whether it has a representation at the current scale, or show only those that do. Turning it OFF is how you check a sheet for annotation that will be missing at that scale.

tools_summary.name: set_annotative
tools_summary.description: Turn the annotative flag on or off for one or more entities. Turning it ON gives the object a representation at the CURRENT annotation scale only - use add_annotation_scale for the others. Turning it OFF collapses it back to a single fixed-size object.

tools_summary.name: set_auto_add_scale
tools_summary.description: ANNOAUTOSCALE: whether annotative objects automatically gain a representation when the current annotation scale changes. On is convenient while drafting and dangerous on an issued set, because objects silently acquire scales nobody asked for.
intent: auto add scale to annotative objects

tools_summary.name: set_current_annotation_scale
tools_summary.description: Set CANNOSCALE - the scale new annotative objects are created at, and the one model space displays. Does NOT retroactively add this scale to existing objects; use add_annotation_scale for that.

tools_summary.name: sync_scale_positions
tools_summary.description: Reset every scale representation of the given objects back to the position of the current scale's representation. Use after moving annotation at one scale and wanting the others to follow rather than drift.
